title: Grateful Dead Live at Stakladen, Aarhus University on 1972-04-16

ai_review.summary: High‑energy second set with a monster Truckin' and inventive Other One jam; soundboard source marred by hiss and first‑set cuts but overall good listening experience.
ai_review.review: The show shines in its second half, delivering a scorching Truckin', an unusually spacious The Other One jam, and tight Me & My Uncle, all highlighted by Jerry’s ripping leads and Phil’s percolating bass. Recording quality is uneven – the first set suffers from hiss, cuts and lower fidelity, while the second set sounds clean and well‑balanced, making it a worthwhile listen despite its flaws.

ai_rating.rationale: Average star rating is ~4.3; most reviewers praise the musical performance (especially the second set) while noting consistent hiss and first‑set issues, leading to a strong but not flawless overall score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Noticeable hiss throughout; first set has cuts and poorer fidelity, second set is clean with solid mix. No major drop‑outs reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set incomplete and unevenly recorded; second set flows through extended jams, unusual minimal‑drum passages, and high‑energy finishes, making it the highlight of the concert.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Ripping guitar solos, especially on Truckin' and the jam sections; lets loose toward the end of Deal, but briefly absent during the final minutes of The Other One jam.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass percolates and locks in tightly with Jerry, creating a standout duet on Truckin'; contributes an engaging thematic thread in The Other One jam.
band_member_comments.Bob: Weir adds aggressive leads during The Other One and drives high energy on Me & My Uncle.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith joins later in the jam, adding texture; otherwise not prominent due to early minimal‑drum arrangement.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill is missing for portions of The Other One jam, returning later; overall drumming supports but is subdued during the more spacious sections.
